notes.title: My Colony v1.13.0 Patch
notes.content: This update fixes some bugs and expands the Russian language translations.  It also removes the bundled music to reduce download size.  The music can be re-added post-install for users who like it.

notes.title: v0.91.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
My Colony v0.91.0 is now available!  This update includes bug fixes, performance upgrades, 1 new tech, 1 new unit, and 8 new buildings.  See the full release notes at the link below, and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: My Colony Patch v0.90.0 Released
notes.content:
The v0.90.0 patch for My Colony is now available!  This is "Information Technology" update #1, and includes a new utility, new resource, new tech, and 17 new structures!  There are other goodies included as well, see the full release notes for more info, and thanks for playing!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=32266

notes.title: Patch v0.84.0 is live!
notes.content:
The My Colony v0.84.0 update is now live.  This update makes changes to two of the maps, adds a new resource called Ether, adds several new Reptilian items, and fixes a few bugs.  See the full release notes at the link below, and thanks for playing!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=29930

notes.title: v0.79.0 Patch Released!
notes.content:
The v0.79.0 patch is now live and includes the following changes:

bug fixes, performance improvements
added build counts to vehicle construction sidebar
Added Wood storage to Quantum and Gravitational Compression warehouses
Added first batch of Russian language translations

See the full release notes here:
https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=28476

Thanks for playing, much more to come!
